Actual Article Body:
By JACQUES PETERSON, US ASSISTANT SHOWBIZ EDITOR

Published:  10:53 AEDT, 16 October 2026   |  Updated:  10:56 AEDT, 16 October 2026

Amanda Bynes and her boyfriend Zachary Khan are still going strong.

The former actress, 40, and her event planner beau kept things casual as they stepped out for iced coffees from Starbucks in Los Angeles on Wednesday.

Bynes wore a speckled grey-ish tracksuit with a white sweater and black boots.

The budding fashion designer accessorized with a black handbag from her own line, New York Speed.

The bags are currently on sale for $218 a piece, which some fans have said is far too expensive.

While Bynes went for an all white look for the outing, Khan rocked black jeans, a matching T-shirt, and a baseball cap.

Amanda Bynes and her event planner boyfriend Zachary Khan kept things casual as they stepped out for iced coffees from Starbucks in Los Angeles on Wednesday

The businessman appeared to be engaged in a tense phone call as he strolled beside Bynes.

This past Valentine's Day the She's The Man star gushed about her boyfriend in an Instagram tribute.

She captioned a video, which showed the couple driving through the city at night, 'love you Zachary.'

They began dating in September 2025 and her 'level-headed' partner has been credited with keeping the troubled child star calm and collected.

Sources previously told the Daily Mail that Khan has brought Bynes 'some stability' after she ended her engagement to Paul Michael for the second time in July 2022.

Bynes has kept busy with creative projects throughout the year, including music releases and peddling handbags from her apparel line.

She also recently lost around 28lbs after going on the GLP-1 Ozempic last year.

Bynes recently shared her emotional reaction to the death of actress Hayden Panettiere.

The budding fashion designer accessorized with a black handbag from her own line, New York Speed

The businessman appeared to be engaged in a tense phone call as he strolled beside Bynes

Panettiere was found dead on August 16 at an Airbnb in Greenville, South Carolina from the 'toxic effects' of multiple drugs – including fentanyl. She was 36.

Bynes shared a short tribute to Panettiere on LinkedIn on August 17, writing: 'Life can hit you hard, and fast. What a horrible situation.'

Accompanying her post were screenshots from a past interview in which Panettiere discussed the pressures and unrealistic expectations of growing up in the Hollywood spotlight.

Bynes left the entertainment industry over a decade ago amid mental health and substance abuse issues.

Her last major role was in the romantic comedy Easy A, starring Emma Stone and Penn Badgley.

The film was a box office hit, grossing $75million at the box office off of its relatively small budget of just $8million.

Despite the film's success, Bynes announced at the time that she was retiring from acting to pursue a fashion career.

She was temporarily attached to the 2011 Farrelly brothers comedy Hall Pass, but she dropped out of the film and was replaced by Alexandra Daddario.
